mapper.select:
SELECT T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, T2.CASH_ID cashId, T2.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, T3.ACCT_NAME acctName,
T1.INT_TYPE rateType,
CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN T1.RATE * 100 ELSE (T1.RATE*T1.COEFFICIENT+T1.SPREAD_RATE) * 100 END AS rate
,CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN to_char(T1.RATE * 100,'9990.99999') ELSE T4.ITEM_VALUE||'*'||trim(to_char(T1.COEFFICIENT,'9990.9999'))||'+'||trim(to_char(T1.SPREAD_RATE*100,'9990.0099999')) END AS rateStr
,T2.CCY ccy ,T1.EFF_DATE effDate ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T3.ACCT_NO order by T1.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T2 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID
LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST T4 ON T4.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' AND T1.BENCHMARK_ID = T4.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
AND (T1.EFF_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{effDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{effDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND T3.ACCT_NO = #{busiAcctNo}

select t.CLOSE_PRICE from( SELECT CLOSE_PRICE,rownumber() over() as rownum FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION WHERE MARKET_ID = #{indexId}
AND EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC ) t where t.rownum = 1

select t.YIELD from( SELECT YIELD,rownumber() over() as rownum FROM MST_YIELD_CURVE_INFO WHERE CURVE_CODE = #{indexId} AND CURVE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY CURVE_DATE DESC ) t where t.rownum = 1

SELECT * FROM( SELECT rownumber() over() AS rn ,T1.CASH_ID cashId ,T1.CCY ccy ,T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo ,T3.ACCT_NAME acctName ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate ,T2.BENCHMARK_ID indexId ,T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE indexSource ,T2.INT_TYPE rateType ,T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType ,T2.BASIS basis
,T2.RATE * 100 as rate
,T2.RATE as currentRate ,T2.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate
FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
1=1 AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T2.EFF_DATE != TO_DATE(#{effDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY T2.eff_Date DESC ) WHERE rn = 1
